description:
Recommend agents for a capability or job with matching reasons and caveats.

    Uses exactly the website/API ranking and stored observations, never a live
    task. Filters are requirements, so an empty shortlist is valid. auth is
    'none' or 'declared'; signature is 'verified'; protocol is JSONRPC,
    HTTP+JSON or GRPC. a2a_confirmed requires the latest current-endpoint
    read-only probe to confirm A2A; it does not prove task quality or safety.
    Observation age is 1..168 hours. max_amount is a
    non-negative amount in human-readable asset units (0.05 means 0.05 USDC
    for a USDC asset) and requires both network and asset with known decimals.
    No price conversion across assets is performed. Returns compact structured
    results (4 KiB per record), total_matches, pagination, ranking_version and
    evidence scope. Use full_record_url or get_agent for full stored details.
name: recommend_agents
